topic: propeller-openwater-bem / W20 item 5: three-density GCI and error decomposition

core_policies.fixed: core_ratio = 0.05 at every level (regularisation held constant)
core_policies.similarity: core_ratio = 0.05 * 16 / n_radial (radius halves with the panel size)

core_inertness_probe.purpose: test whether the predeclared core policies (0.025/0.05/0.10) can change K_T at the densities of this study
core_inertness_probe.mechanism: src/tensorbem/propeller.py solve_lifting_surface clamps the segment core to max(core_ratio*|segment|, 0.5*strip_width); at these panel densities the 0.5*strip_width floor dominates for core_ratio <= 0.10, so the desingularisation radius does not follow core_ratio there

criteria.statement: three mission advance ratios x three panel densities x K_T/10K_Q, all finite
criteria.threshold: 9 level values per quantity, all finite

criteria.statement: every level yields K_T > 0 and resisting K_Q > 0 at the mission advance ratios
observed order within 30 % of p_th = 2 at every mission J
fine-grid GCI is tabulated for both quantities at every mission J and the 3 % acceptance is answered
criteria.threshold: tabulated (no threshold on GCI itself; the answer is reported)

criteria.statement: discretisation + model term equals the total anchor deviation
|dK_T| and |dK_Q| at J = 0.70 are reported and the 3 % question is answered explicitly
the observed-order verdict does not depend on the vortex-core policy
criteria.threshold: identical W3 verdict under both policies AND the policies are distinguishable

measured.interpretation: NOT TESTABLE: the two policies return bit-identical K_T/10K_Q at the L1 and L3 densities (see core_inertness_probe), so agreement cannot be evidence of robustness and the criterion is failed closed

criteria.statement: a decomposition that does not require a valid observed order is reported for every cell
criteria.threshold: last-increment band and model bounds present for KT and 10KQ at every J

limitations: The anchor is a SECONDARY_REPRODUCTION of the KRISO KP505 open-water test (see papers/data/w20-anchors/kp505_transcription.json); the model term computed here therefore contains both the lattice's formulation error and the anchor's own transcription uncertainty.

Three levels give one observed order with no way to check that the asymptotic range has been reached; the four-level single-axis ladders of benchmarks/verified/propeller_openwater/kp505_gci_ladder.json already showed that the two overlapping triplets of the same ladder can disagree, so the fine-grid GCI here is a lower-bound-flavoured estimate, not a proof.
eta0 is a derived ratio of K_T and 10 K_Q and is reported for completeness only; no criterion is attached to it.
